title: Can Reasoning and Image Description Enhance Yes/No Visual Mathematical Understanding?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general visual tasks, yet their ability to understand mathematical images remains limited. This paper investigates whether explicit reasoning and textual image descriptions can enhance VLMs' performance on binary yes/no visual mathematical questions. To achieve this, we curated a paired evaluation set to benchmark prominent open-source VLMs under varying prompt and input conditions. In particular, we leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and use textual descriptions, either replacing or augmenting visual inputs, to isolate and evaluate mathematical comprehension. translated_title: 推理与图像描述能否增强是/否型视觉数学理解能力？
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）在通用视觉任务上已取得强劲表现，但其理解数学图像的能力仍然有限。本文研究了显式推理和文本化的图像描述能否提升VLMs在二元是/否型视觉数学问题上的表现。为此，我们精心构建了一个配对评估集，在不同的提示与输入条件下对知名开源VLMs进行基准测试。特别地，我们采用思维链提示，并使用文本描述来替换或增强视觉输入，从而分离并评估模型的数学理解能力。结果显示，显式推理能够提升性能，尤其在配对一致性准确率方面表现突出；而文本图像描述并不能持续带来帮助，甚至可能降低性能。这些发现表明，推理对于稳定的视觉数学判断至关重要，而描述性文本输入的作用则较为有限。
tldr: 本文通过配对评估发现，思维链等显式推理能显著提升视觉语言模型在是/否型视觉数学问题上的表现，而文本图像描述反而可能损害性能。
en_tdlr: This study shows that explicit reasoning (CoT prompting) enhances VLMs' performance on binary yes/no visual mathematical questions, while textual image descriptions may actually degrade performance.
